تنتشقوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَشِقُوا (tantašiqū) /tan.ta.ʃi.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# تُنْتَشَقُوا (tuntašaqū) /tun.ta.ʃa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
